explanation_ne: निर्वाचन आयोग नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को धारा २४५ अन्तर्गत गठन गरिएको हो।

question: Under which article of the Constitution of Nepal 2072 is the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority constituted?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को कुन धाराअन्तर्गत अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोग गठन गरिएको हो?
explanation: The Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority is constituted under Article 238 of the Constitution of Nepal 2072.
explanation_ne: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोग नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को धारा २३८ अन्तर्गत गठन गरिएको हो।

question: Under which article of the Constitution of Nepal 2072 is the Auditor General constituted?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को कुन धाराअन्तर्गत महालेखा परीक्षक गठन गरिएको हो?
explanation: The Auditor General is constituted under Article 241 of the Constitution of Nepal 2072.
explanation_ne: महालेखा परीक्षक नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को धारा २४१ अन्तर्गत गठन गरिएको हो।

question: Under which article of the Constitution of Nepal 2072 is the Public Service Commission constituted?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को कुन धाराअन्तर्गत लोक सेवा आयोग गठन गरिएको हो?
explanation: The Public Service Commission is constituted under Article 242 of the Constitution of Nepal 2072.
explanation_ne: लोक सेवा आयोग नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को धारा २४२ अन्तर्गत गठन गरिएको हो।

question: Under which article of the Constitution of Nepal 2072 is the National Women Commission constituted?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को कुन धाराअन्तर्गत राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोग गठन गरिएको हो?
explanation: The National Women Commission is constituted under Article 252 of the Constitution of Nepal 2072.
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोग नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को धारा २५२ अन्तर्गत गठन गरिएको हो।

question: Under which article of the Constitution of Nepal 2072 is the National Dalit Commission constituted?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को कुन धाराअन्तर्गत राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोग गठन गरिएको हो?
explanation: The National Dalit Commission is constituted under Article 255 of the Constitution of Nepal 2072.
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोग नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को धारा २५५ अन्तर्गत गठन गरिएको हो।

question: Under which article of the Constitution of Nepal 2072 is the National Inclusion Commission constituted?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को कुन धाराअन्तर्गत राष्ट्रिय समावेशी आयोग गठन गरिएको हो?
explanation: The National Inclusion Commission is constituted under Article 258 of the Constitution of Nepal 2072.
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रिय समावेशी आयोग नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को धारा २५८ अन्तर्गत गठन गरिएको हो।

question: Under which article of the Constitution of Nepal 2072 is the Muslim Commission constituted?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को कुन धाराअन्तर्गत मुस्लिम आयोग गठन गरिएको हो?
explanation: The Muslim Commission is constituted under Article 261 of the Constitution of Nepal 2072.
explanation_ne: मुस्लिम आयोग नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को धारा २६१ अन्तर्गत गठन गरिएको हो।

question: According to Article 56 of the Constitution, how many tiers of government does Nepal have?
question_ne: संविधानको धारा ५६ अनुसार नेपालमा सरकारका कति तह छन्?
options: Four — federal, provincial, district and local
options_ne: चार — सङ्घ, प्रदेश, जिल्ला र स्थानीय
explanation: Article 56 provides a three-tier structure: federal, provincial and local levels.
explanation_ne: धारा ५६ ले सङ्घ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय गरी तीन तहको संरचना व्यवस्था गरेको छ।

question: How many local levels are there in Nepal at present?
question_ne: हाल नेपालमा कति स्थानीय तह छन्?
explanation: Nepal has 753 local levels: 6 metropolitan cities, 11 sub-metropolitan cities, 276 municipalities and 460 rural municipalities.
explanation_ne: नेपालमा ७५३ स्थानीय तह छन्: ६ महानगरपालिका, ११ उपमहानगरपालिका, २७६ नगरपालिका र ४६० गाउँपालिका।
source: Constitution of Nepal 2072; Ministry of Federal Affairs

question: How many districts and provinces does Nepal have?
question_ne: नेपालमा कति जिल्ला र प्रदेश छन्?
explanation: Nepal has 77 districts and 7 provinces.
explanation_ne: नेपालमा ७७ जिल्ला र ७ प्रदेश छन्।

question: How many members does the House of Representatives have, and how are they elected?
question_ne: प्रतिनिधि सभामा कति सदस्य हुन्छन् र तिनीहरू कसरी निर्वाचित हुन्छन्?
options: 275 — 165 by first-past-the-post and 110 by proportional representation
240 — 165 by first-past-the-post and 75 by proportional representation
300 — 200 by first-past-the-post and 100 by proportional representation
275 — 165 by proportional representation and 110 by first-past-the-post
options_ne: २७५ — १६५ by first-past-the-post and ११० by proportional representation
२४० — १६५ by first-past-the-post and ७५ by proportional representation
३०० — २०० by first-past-the-post and १०० by proportional representation
२७५ — १६५ by proportional representation and ११० by first-past-the-post
explanation: The House of Representatives has 275 members: 165 elected by first-past-the-post and 110 by proportional representation (Article 84).
explanation_ne: प्रतिनिधि सभामा २७५ सदस्य हुन्छन्: १६५ प्रत्यक्ष निर्वाचन प्रणालीबाट र ११० समानुपातिक निर्वाचन प्रणालीबाट (धारा ८४)।

question: How many members does the National Assembly have?
question_ne: राष्ट्रिय सभामा कति सदस्य हुन्छन्?
options: 59 — 56 elected (8 per province) and 3 nominated by the President
options_ne: ५९ — ५६ elected (८ per province) and ३ nominated by the President
explanation: The National Assembly has 59 members: 8 from each of the 7 provinces (56) plus 3 nominated by the President on the Government's recommendation (Article 86).
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रिय सभामा ५९ सदस्य हुन्छन्: ७ प्रदेशबाट ८/८ जना (५६) र राष्ट्रपतिबाट मनोनीत ३ जना (धारा ८६)।

question: What is the term of the House of Representatives under the Constitution?
question_ne: संविधान अनुसार प्रतिनिधि सभाको कार्यकाल कति हो?
explanation: The term of the House of Representatives is five years (Article 88).
explanation_ne: प्रतिनिधि सभाको कार्यकाल पाँच वर्ष हो (धारा ८८)।

question: Under Article 61, who is the head of state of Nepal?
question_ne: धारा ६१ अनुसार नेपालको राष्ट्र प्रमुख को हो?
explanation: The President is the head of state of Nepal (Article 61).
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रपति नेपालको राष्ट्र प्रमुख हुन् (धारा ६१)।

question: Under Article 74, in whom is the executive power of Nepal vested?
question_ne: धारा ७४ अनुसार नेपालको कार्यकारिणी अधिकार कसमा निहित छ?
explanation: The executive power of Nepal is vested in the Council of Ministers (Article 74).
explanation_ne: नेपालको कार्यकारिणी अधिकार मन्त्रिपरिषद्मा निहित छ (धारा ७४)।

question: Who appoints the Prime Minister of Nepal under Article 76?
question_ne: धारा ७६ अनुसार नेपालको प्रधानमन्त्री नियुक्त गर्ने को हो?
explanation: The Prime Minister is appointed by the President (Article 76).
explanation_ne: प्रधानमन्त्री राष्ट्रपतिद्वारा नियुक्त हुन्छन् (धारा ७६)।

question: How many justices, including the Chief Justice, sit in the Supreme Court of Nepal?
question_ne: सर्वोच्च अदालतमा प्रधानन्यायाधीशसहित कति न्यायाधीश रहन्छन्?
options: Up to 11 justices in addition to the Chief Justice
Up to 25 justices in addition to the Chief Justice
Up to 15 justices in addition to the Chief Justice
Up to 20 justices in addition to the Chief Justice
options_ne: Up to ११ justices in addition to the Chief Justice
Up to २५ justices in addition to the Chief Justice
Up to १५ justices in addition to the Chief Justice
Up to २० justices in addition to the Chief Justice
explanation: The Supreme Court has a Chief Justice and up to twenty other justices (Article 129).
explanation_ne: सर्वोच्च अदालतमा प्रधानन्यायाधीश र बढीमा अन्य बीस जना न्यायाधीश रहन्छन् (धारा १२९)।

question: Which body recommends the appointment of Supreme Court justices in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीश नियुक्तिका लागि सिफारिस गर्ने निकाय कुन हो?
explanation: The Judicial Council recommends appointments of Supreme Court justices (Article 153).
explanation_ne: न्याय परिषद्ले सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीश नियुक्तिका लागि सिफारिस गर्छ (धारा १५३)।

question: Under Article 11, a person whose father or mother was a Nepali citizen at the time of their birth acquires citizenship by what means?
question_ne: धारा ११ अनुसार जन्मको समयमा बुबा वा आमा नेपाली नागरिक भएको व्यक्ति कुन माध्यमबाट नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्छ?
explanation: Citizenship by descent is acquired when the father or mother was a Nepali citizen at the time of birth (Article 11(2)).
explanation_ne: जन्मको समयमा बुबा वा आमा नेपाली नागरिक भएमा वंशजको आधारमा नागरिकता प्राप्त हुन्छ (धारा ११(२))।

question: Which article of the Constitution deals with the acquisition of citizenship by a foreign woman married to a Nepali citizen?
question_ne: नेपाली नागरिकसँग विवाह गरेकी विदेशी महिलाको नागरिकता प्राप्तिसम्बन्धी व्यवस्था कुन धारामा छ?
explanation: Article 11(6) provides that a foreign woman married to a Nepali citizen may acquire naturalised citizenship if she initiates action to renounce her foreign citizenship.
explanation_ne: धारा ११(६) अनुसार नेपाली नागरिकसँग विवाह गरेकी विदेशी महिलाले आफ्नो विदेशी नागरिकता त्याग्ने प्रक्रिया सुरु गरेमा अङ्गीकृत नागरिकता पाउन सक्छिन्।

question: Under Article 7, what is the official language of Nepal?
question_ne: धारा ७ अनुसार नेपालको सरकारी कामकाजको भाषा कुन हो?
explanation: Nepali in the Devanagari script is the official language of Nepal (Article 7(1)).
explanation_ne: देवनागरी लिपिमा लेखिने नेपाली भाषा नेपालको सरकारी कामकाजको भाषा हो (धारा ७(१))।

question: How many items are listed in Schedule 5 (List of Federal Powers)?
question_ne: अनुसूची ५ (सङ्घको अधिकारको सूची) मा कति विषय छन्?
explanation: Schedule 5 lists 35 federal powers.
explanation_ne: अनुसूची ५ मा ३५ वटा सङ्घीय अधिकार सूचीबद्ध छन्।

question: How many items are listed in Schedule 8 (List of Local Level Powers)?
question_ne: अनुसूची ८ (स्थानीय तहको अधिकारको सूची) मा कति विषय छन्?
explanation: Schedule 8 lists 22 local-level powers.
explanation_ne: अनुसूची ८ मा २२ वटा स्थानीय तहका अधिकार सूचीबद्ध छन्।

question: How many items are in Schedule 6 (List of Provincial Powers)?
question_ne: अनुसूची ६ (प्रदेशको अधिकारको सूची) मा कति विषय छन्?
explanation: Schedule 6 lists 21 provincial powers.
explanation_ne: अनुसूची ६ मा २१ वटा प्रदेशीय अधिकार सूचीबद्ध छन्।

question: Under Article 58, to whom do residuary powers belong?
question_ne: धारा ५८ अनुसार अवशिष्ट अधिकार कसलाई प्राप्त हुन्छ?
explanation: Residuary powers rest with the Federation (Article 58).
explanation_ne: अवशिष्ट अधिकार सङ्घमा निहित हुन्छ (धारा ५८)।

question: Which article of the Constitution provides for the distribution of state power among the three tiers?
question_ne: तीनै तहबीच राज्यशक्तिको बाँडफाँटसम्बन्धी व्यवस्था कुन धारामा छ?
explanation: Article 57 provides for the distribution of state power, detailed in Schedules 5 to 9.
explanation_ne: धारा ५७ ले राज्यशक्तिको बाँडफाँटको व्यवस्था गर्छ, जसको विवरण अनुसूची ५ देखि ९ मा छ।

question: Under Article 168, who appoints the Chief Minister of a province?
question_ne: धारा १६८ अनुसार प्रदेशको मुख्यमन्त्री नियुक्त गर्ने को हो?
explanation: The Province Head appoints the Chief Minister (Article 168).
explanation_ne: प्रदेश प्रमुखले मुख्यमन्त्री नियुक्त गर्छन् (धारा १६८)।

question: Under Article 215, the Village Assembly and Municipal Assembly are composed of which office-bearers?
question_ne: धारा २१५ अनुसार गाउँ सभा र नगर सभामा कुन पदाधिकारीहरू रहन्छन्?
options: Only the chairperson and the chief administrative officer
Chairperson/Mayor, Vice-Chairperson/Deputy Mayor, ward chairpersons and members
Members nominated by the Province Head
options_ne: अध्यक्ष र प्रमुख प्रशासकीय अधिकृत मात्र
अध्यक्ष/प्रमुख, उपाध्यक्ष/उपप्रमुख, वडा अध्यक्षहरू र सदस्यहरू
explanation: The Village/Municipal Assembly comprises the chairperson/mayor, vice-chairperson/deputy mayor, ward chairpersons and members (Article 215).
explanation_ne: गाउँ/नगर सभा अध्यक्ष/प्रमुख, उपाध्यक्ष/उपप्रमुख, वडा अध्यक्षहरू र सदस्यहरूबाट बनेको हुन्छ (धारा २१५)।

question: Which part of the Constitution contains the Directive Principles and Policies of the State?
question_ne: संविधानको कुन भागमा राज्यका निर्देशक सिद्धान्त तथा नीतिहरू छन्?
explanation: Part 4 (Articles 50–55) contains the Directive Principles and Policies of the State.
explanation_ne: भाग ४ (धारा ५०–५५) मा राज्यका निर्देशक सिद्धान्त तथा नीतिहरू छन्।

question: Are the Directive Principles and Policies of the State enforceable in a court of law?
question_ne: राज्यका निर्देशक सिद्धान्त तथा नीतिहरू अदालतमा कार्यान्वयन गर्न सकिन्छ?
options: Yes — but only through the Supreme Court
No — they are guidelines, not justiciable
Only the policies on education are enforceable
options_ne: होइन — तिनीहरू मार्गदर्शक सिद्धान्त हुन्, न्यायिक उपचार योग्य छैनन्
शिक्षासम्बन्धी नीतिहरू मात्र कार्यान्वयन योग्य छन्
explanation: Directive Principles are fundamental in governance but are not enforceable in any court (Article 55).
explanation_ne: निर्देशक सिद्धान्तहरू शासनका लागि मौलिक छन् तर कुनै अदालतमा कार्यान्वयन योग्य छैनन् (धारा ५५)।

question: How was the second amendment to the Constitution of Nepal 2072 (2020) mainly related to?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ को दोस्रो संशोधन (२०२०) मुख्यतः केसँग सम्बन्धित थियो?
options: Changing the federal structure from 7 to 5 provinces
Updating the national map and coat of arms to include Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura
Removing the provision of proportional representation
Extending the term of the House of Representatives
options_ne: Changing the federal structure from ७ to ५ provinces
Updating the national map and coat of arms to include Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura
Removing the provision of proportional representation
Extending the term of the House of Representatives
explanation: The second amendment (2077) updated Schedule 3 (coat of arms) with the new political map including Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura.
explanation_ne: दोस्रो संशोधन (२०७७) ले कालापानी, लिपुलेक र लिम्पियाधुरा समेटिएको नयाँ राजनीतिक नक्सासहित अनुसूची ३ (राष्ट्रिय चिह्न) अद्यावधिक गर्यो।

question: What majority is required in the Federal Parliament to amend the Constitution of Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान संशोधन गर्न सङ्घीय संसद्मा कति बहुमत आवश्यक पर्छ?
options: Three-fourths majority of the House of Representatives alone
Two-thirds majority of the total members of both Houses
options_ne: दुवै सदनका सम्पूर्ण सदस्यहरूको दुई-तिहाइ बहुमत
explanation: A constitutional amendment bill must be passed by a two-thirds majority of the total membership of each House (Article 274).
explanation_ne: संविधान संशोधन विधेयक प्रत्येक सदनका सम्पूर्ण सदस्यहरूको दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट पारित हुनुपर्छ (धारा २७४)।

question: In which year was the Public Service Commission of Nepal established?
question_ne: नेपालको लोक सेवा आयोग कुन वर्षमा स्थापना भएको थियो?
explanation: The Public Service Commission was established on 15 June 1951 (1 Ashad 2008 BS).
explanation_ne: लोक सेवा आयोग २००८ असार १ (१५ जुन १९५१) मा स्थापना भएको थियो।

question: Which constitutional body investigates abuse of authority by public office holders in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा सार्वजनिक पद धारण गरेका व्यक्तिको अधिकार दुरुपयोग छानबिन गर्ने संवैधानिक निकाय कुन हो?
options: Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA)
explanation: The CIAA investigates improper conduct and corruption by public office holders (Article 238).
explanation_ne: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोगले सार्वजनिक पदाधिकारीको अनुचित कार्य र भ्रष्टाचारको छानबिन गर्छ (धारा २३८)।

question: Who is the chief legal advisor to the Government of Nepal?
question_ne: नेपाल सरकारको मुख्य कानुनी सल्लाहकार को हो?
explanation: The Attorney General is the chief legal advisor to the Government of Nepal (Article 157).
explanation_ne: महान्यायाधिवक्ता नेपाल सरकारको मुख्य कानुनी सल्लाहकार हुन् (धारा १५७)।

question: What is the minimum age to be eligible for election as a member of the House of Representatives?
question_ne: प्रतिनिधि सभाको सदस्यमा निर्वाचित हुन न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ?
explanation: A candidate for the House of Representatives must have completed 25 years of age (Article 87).
explanation_ne: प्रतिनिधि सभाको सदस्यको उम्मेदवारले २५ वर्ष उमेर पूरा गरेको हुनुपर्छ (धारा ८७)।

question: What is the minimum age to be eligible for election as a member of the National Assembly?
question_ne: राष्ट्रिय सभाको सदस्यमा निर्वाचित हुन न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ?
explanation: A candidate for the National Assembly must have completed 35 years of age (Article 87).
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रिय सभाको सदस्यको उम्मेदवारले ३५ वर्ष उमेर पूरा गरेको हुनुपर्छ (धारा ८७)।

question: What is the minimum age required to be eligible for the office of President of Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालको राष्ट्रपति हुन न्यूनतम उमेर कति हुनुपर्छ?
explanation: A person must have completed 45 years of age to be eligible for the office of President (Article 64).
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रपति पदका लागि उम्मेदवारले ४५ वर्ष उमेर पूरा गरेको हुनुपर्छ (धारा ६४)।

question: Which article guarantees the right to vote in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा मतदानको हकको प्रत्याभूति कुन धाराले गरेको छ?
options: Article 84(5) and Article 176 — every Nepali citizen who has completed 18 years of age has the right to vote
options_ne: Article ८४(५) and Article १७६ — every Nepali citizen who has completed १८ years of age has the right to vote
explanation: Every Nepali citizen who has completed 18 years of age has the right to vote (Articles 84(5), 176(5) and 222).
explanation_ne: १८ वर्ष उमेर पूरा गरेका प्रत्येक नेपाली नागरिकलाई मतदानको हक हुन्छ (धारा ८४(५), १७६(५) र २२२)।

question: Under Article 100, a motion of no confidence against the Prime Minister cannot be moved within how long after a vote of confidence?
question_ne: धारा १०० अनुसार विश्वासको मत प्राप्त गरेको कति समयभित्र प्रधानमन्त्रीविरुद्ध अविश्वासको प्रस्ताव ल्याउन सकिँदैन?
explanation: A no-confidence motion cannot be moved within two years of a vote of confidence, unless moved by the same party that formed the government in specified circumstances (Article 100(5)).
explanation_ne: विश्वासको मत प्राप्त गरेको दुई वर्षभित्र अविश्वासको प्रस्ताव ल्याउन सकिँदैन (धारा १००(५))।

question: Which schedule lists the concurrent powers of the Federation and the Province?
question_ne: सङ्घ र प्रदेशको साझा अधिकारको सूची कुन अनुसूचीमा छ?
explanation: Schedule 7 lists the concurrent powers of the Federation and the Province (25 items).
explanation_ne: अनुसूची ७ मा सङ्घ र प्रदेशको साझा अधिकार (२५ विषय) को सूची छ।

question: How many items are listed in Schedule 9 (concurrent powers of Federation, Province and Local Level)?
question_ne: अनुसूची ९ (सङ्घ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहको साझा अधिकार) मा कति विषय छन्?
explanation: Schedule 9 lists 15 concurrent powers of all three tiers.
explanation_ne: अनुसूची ९ मा तीनै तहका १५ साझा अधिकार सूचीबद्ध छन्।

question: What does the Preamble of the Constitution of Nepal begin with?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधानको प्रस्तावना के बाट सुरु हुन्छ?
options: "We, the People of Nepal, in order to form a more perfect union"
"In the name of the people of Nepal"
options_ne: “हामी, नेपाली जनता, अझ पूर्ण सङ्घ बनाउनका लागि”
explanation: The Preamble begins: 'We, the Sovereign People of Nepal...'.
explanation_ne: प्रस्तावना यसरी सुरु हुन्छ: 'हामी सार्वभौमसत्ता सम्पन्न नेपाली जनता...'।

question: Under Article 51, the policies of the State include a policy to do what regarding the use of natural resources?
question_ne: धारा ५१ अनुसार राज्यका नीतिहरूमा प्राकृतिक स्रोतको उपयोगबारे के व्यवस्था छ?
options: To lease all forests to private companies
To protect, promote and use natural resources sustainably for the benefit of the people
To ban the use of water resources
To nationalise all natural resources immediately
options_ne: सबै वन निजी कम्पनीलाई भाडामा दिनु
प्राकृतिक स्रोतहरूको जनहितमा दिगो संरक्षण, संवर्द्धन र उपयोग गर्नु
सबै प्राकृतिक स्रोत तत्काल राष्ट्रियकरण गर्नु
explanation: State policy includes the sustainable protection, promotion and use of natural resources for the welfare of the people (Article 51).
explanation_ne: राज्यको नीतिमा प्राकृतिक स्रोतहरूको दिगो संरक्षण, संवर्द्धन र जनहितमा उपयोग गर्ने व्यवस्था छ (धारा ५१)।

question: How many members does a District Assembly (Article 220) include from each local level?
question_ne: धारा २२० अनुसार जिल्ला सभामा प्रत्येक स्थानीय तहबाट कति जना सदस्य रहन्छन्?
options: Five members from each local level
The chairperson and vice-chairperson of each rural municipality and the mayor and deputy mayor of each municipality
options_ne: प्रत्येक स्थानीय तहबाट पाँच जना सदस्य
प्रत्येक गाउँपालिकाका अध्यक्ष र उपाध्यक्ष तथा प्रत्येक नगरपालिकाका प्रमुख र उपप्रमुख
explanation: The District Assembly comprises the chairperson and vice-chairperson of every rural municipality and the mayor and deputy mayor of every municipality in the district (Article 220).
explanation_ne: जिल्ला सभा जिल्लाभित्रका प्रत्येक गाउँपालिकाका अध्यक्ष र उपाध्यक्ष तथा प्रत्येक नगरपालिकाका प्रमुख र उपप्रमुखबाट बनेको हुन्छ (धारा २२०)।

question: Under the Constitution, the Election Commission must hold elections for the House of Representatives within how many months of the expiry of its term or dissolution?
question_ne: संविधान अनुसार निर्वाचन आयोगले प्रतिनिधि सभाको कार्यकाल समाप्त वा विघटन भएको कति महिनाभित्र निर्वाचन गराउनुपर्छ?
explanation: Elections must be held within six months of the expiry of the term or dissolution of the House of Representatives (Article 93).
explanation_ne: प्रतिनिधि सभाको कार्यकाल समाप्त वा विघटन भएको छ महिनाभित्र निर्वाचन गराउनुपर्छ (धारा ९३)।

question: Which article of the Constitution provides that Nepal is a federal democratic republic?
question_ne: नेपाल सङ्घीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्र हो भन्ने व्यवस्था कुन धारामा छ?
explanation: Article 4 declares Nepal an independent, indivisible, sovereign, secular, inclusive, democratic, socialism-oriented federal democratic republican state.
explanation_ne: धारा ४ ले नेपाललाई स्वतन्त्र, अविभाज्य, सार्वभौमसत्ता सम्पन्न, धर्मनिरपेक्ष, समावेशी, लोकतान्त्रिक, समाजवादउन्मुख सङ्घीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्रात्मक राज्य घोषणा गर्छ।

question: In which article is it stated that sovereignty and state authority are vested in the Nepali people?
question_ne: सार्वभौमसत्ता र राजकीय सत्ता नेपाली जनतामा निहित छ भन्ने व्यवस्था कुन धारामा छ?
explanation: Article 2: sovereignty and state authority are vested in the Nepali people.
explanation_ne: धारा २: सार्वभौमसत्ता र राजकीय सत्ता नेपाली जनतामा निहित छ।

question: What is the maximum number of members in the Council of Ministers under the Constitution?
question_ne: संविधान अनुसार मन्त्रिपरिषद्मा बढीमा कति सदस्य रहन सक्छन्?
explanation: The Council of Ministers shall not have more than twenty-five members (Article 76(9)).
explanation_ne: मन्त्रिपरिषद्मा बढीमा पच्चीस जना सदस्य रहन सक्छन् (धारा ७६(९))।

question: When Parliament is not in session, who may issue an ordinance on the recommendation of the Council of Ministers?
question_ne: संसद् अधिवेशन नचलेको बेला मन्त्रिपरिषद्को सिफारिसमा अध्यादेश कसले जारी गर्न सक्छ?
explanation: The President may issue an ordinance on the recommendation of the Council of Ministers when Parliament is not in session (Article 114).
explanation_ne: संसद् अधिवेशन नचलेको बेला मन्त्रिपरिषद्को सिफारिसमा राष्ट्रपतिले अध्यादेश जारी गर्न सक्छन् (धारा ११४)।

question: Which five writs can the Supreme Court issue under its extraordinary jurisdiction (Article 133)?
question_ne: धारा १३३ अन्तर्गतको असाधारण अधिकारक्षेत्र प्रयोग गरी सर्वोच्च अदालतले कुन पाँच रिट जारी गर्न सक्छ?
options: Habeas corpus, injunction, appeal, review and revision
Habeas corpus, mandamus, certiorari, contempt and review
Habeas corpus, mandamus, certiorari, prohibition and quo warranto
Mandamus, certiorari, prohibition, appeal and pardon
options_ne: बन्दीप्रत्यक्षीकरण, निषेधाज्ञा, पुनरावेदन, पुनरावलोकन र पुनरीक्षण
बन्दीप्रत्यक्षीकरण, परमादेश, उत्प्रेषण, अवहेलना र पुनरावलोकन
बन्दीप्रत्यक्षीकरण, परमादेश, उत्प्रेषण, प्रतिषेध र अधिकारपृच्छा
परमादेश, उत्प्रेषण, प्रतिषेध, पुनरावेदन र माफी
explanation: Under Article 133 the Supreme Court may issue habeas corpus, mandamus, certiorari, prohibition and quo warranto.
explanation_ne: धारा १३३ अन्तर्गत सर्वोच्च अदालतले बन्दीप्रत्यक्षीकरण, परमादेश, उत्प्रेषण, प्रतिषेध र अधिकारपृच्छा रिट जारी गर्न सक्छ।

question: How many justices sit on the Constitutional Bench of the Supreme Court?
question_ne: सर्वोच्च अदालतको संवैधानिक इजलासमा कति न्यायाधीश रहन्छन्?
explanation: The Constitutional Bench consists of the Chief Justice and four other justices (Article 137).
explanation_ne: संवैधानिक इजलास प्रधानन्यायाधीशसहित पाँच जना न्यायाधीशबाट बनेको हुन्छ (धारा १३७)।

question: What is the composition of the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA)?
question_ne: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोगको संरचना कस्तो छ?
options: A Chief Commissioner and two other Commissioners
A Chief Commissioner and four other Commissioners
options_ne: एक अध्यक्ष र छ जना सदस्य
एक प्रमुख आयुक्त र अन्य दुई आयुक्त
एक प्रमुख आयुक्त र अन्य चार आयुक्त
explanation: The CIAA consists of a Chief Commissioner and four other Commissioners (Article 238).
explanation_ne: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोगमा एक प्रमुख आयुक्त र अन्य चार आयुक्त रहन्छन् (धारा २३८)।

question: What is the term of office of the Auditor General of Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालको महालेखा परीक्षकको कार्यकाल कति हो?
options: Six years, for a single term only
options_ne: छ वर्ष, एक कार्यकालका लागि मात्र
पाँच वर्ष, एक पटक नवीकरण गर्न सकिने
चार वर्ष, एक पटक नवीकरण गर्न सकिने
छ वर्ष, एक पटक नवीकरण गर्न सकिने
explanation: The Auditor General holds office for six years and is not eligible for reappointment (Article 241).
explanation_ne: महालेखा परीक्षकको कार्यकाल छ वर्ष हुन्छ र उनी पुनः नियुक्त हुन सक्दैनन् (धारा २४१)।

question: How many commissioners, including the Chief Election Commissioner, does the Election Commission have?
question_ne: निर्वाचन आयोगमा प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्तसहित कति आयुक्त रहन्छन्?
explanation: The Election Commission consists of the Chief Election Commissioner and four other Commissioners (Article 245).
explanation_ne: निर्वाचन आयोगमा प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्तसहित पाँच जना आयुक्त रहन्छन् (धारा २४५)।

question: Which province has the largest Provincial Assembly, and how many members does it have?
question_ne: कुन प्रदेशको प्रदेश सभा सबैभन्दा ठूलो छ र त्यसमा कति सदस्य छन्?
explanation: Bagmati Province has the largest Provincial Assembly with 110 members; Karnali has the smallest with 40.
explanation_ne: बागमती प्रदेशको प्रदेश सभा सबैभन्दा ठूलो छ — ११० सदस्य; कर्णालीको सबैभन्दा सानो छ — ४० सदस्य।

question: How many members does a District Coordination Committee have?
question_ne: जिल्ला समन्वय समितिमा कति सदस्य रहन्छन्?
explanation: The District Coordination Committee consists of nine members, including a chief and deputy chief (Article 221).
explanation_ne: जिल्ला समन्वय समितिमा प्रमुख र उपप्रमुखसहित नौ जना सदस्य रहन्छन् (धारा २२१)।

question: According to the Local Government Operation Act 2074, what population is required for an area to be declared a metropolitan city?
question_ne: स्थानीय सरकार सञ्चालन ऐन, २०७४ अनुसार महानगरपालिका घोषणा गर्न कति जनसङ्ख्या आवश्यक पर्छ?
explanation: A metropolitan city requires a population of at least 500,000 (Local Government Operation Act 2074).
explanation_ne: महानगरपालिका हुन कम्तीमा पाँच लाख जनसङ्ख्या आवश्यक पर्छ (स्थानीय सरकार सञ्चालन ऐन, २०७४)।

question: What population is required for an area to be declared a sub-metropolitan city in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा उपमहानगरपालिका घोषणा गर्न कति जनसङ्ख्या आवश्यक पर्छ?
explanation: A sub-metropolitan city requires a population of at least 200,000 (Local Government Operation Act 2074).
explanation_ne: उपमहानगरपालिका हुन कम्तीमा दुई लाख जनसङ्ख्या आवश्यक पर्छ (स्थानीय सरकार सञ्चालन ऐन, २०७४)।

question: What must every ward committee in Nepal include under the Constitution?
question_ne: संविधान अनुसार नेपालको प्रत्येक वडा समितिमा के अनिवार्य रूपमा रहनुपर्छ?
options: At least two women members, one of whom is a Dalit woman
At least five members, all directly elected
At least one teacher and one health worker
At least three men and two women
options_ne: कम्तीमा दुई महिला सदस्य, जसमध्ये एक दलित महिला
कम्तीमा पाँच सदस्य, सबै प्रत्यक्ष निर्वाचित
कम्तीमा एक शिक्षक र एक स्वास्थ्यकर्मी
कम्तीमा तीन पुरुष र दुई महिला
explanation: Each ward committee has a ward chairperson and four members, of whom at least two must be women, including one Dalit woman.
explanation_ne: प्रत्येक वडा समितिमा वडा अध्यक्ष र चार सदस्य रहन्छन्, जसमध्ये कम्तीमा दुई महिला हुनुपर्छ र एक जना दलित महिला हुनुपर्छ।

question: Which article of the Constitution sets out the fundamental duties of citizens?
question_ne: संविधानको कुन धारामा नागरिकका मौलिक कर्तव्यहरू उल्लेख छन्?
explanation: Article 48 sets out the fundamental duties of every citizen, including safeguarding nationality, sovereignty and national integrity.
explanation_ne: धारा ४८ मा प्रत्येक नागरिकका मौलिक कर्तव्यहरू उल्लेख छन्, जसमा राष्ट्रियता, सार्वभौमसत्ता र राष्ट्रिय अखण्डताको रक्षा पनि पर्छ।

question: Under Article 47, within how long must laws be made to implement the fundamental rights?
question_ne: धारा ४७ अनुसार मौलिक हक कार्यान्वयन गर्न कानुन कति समयभित्र बनाइनुपर्छ?
options: Within three years of the commencement of the Constitution
explanation: Laws for the implementation of fundamental rights were to be made within three years of the commencement of the Constitution (Article 47).
explanation_ne: मौलिक हक कार्यान्वयनका लागि कानुन संविधान प्रारम्भ भएको तीन वर्षभित्र बनाइनुपर्ने व्यवस्था धारा ४७ मा छ।

question: Under the revenue-sharing arrangement, how are VAT and excise duty revenues shared among the three tiers?
question_ne: राजस्व बाँडफाँट व्यवस्थाअनुसार भ्याट र अन्तःशुल्कको राजस्व तीन तहबीच कसरी बाँडिन्छ?
explanation: VAT and excise duty are shared as 70% federal, 15% provincial and 15% local (Intergovernmental Fiscal Arrangement Act 2074).
explanation_ne: भ्याट र अन्तःशुल्क सङ्घ ७०%, प्रदेश १५% र स्थानीय १५% गरी बाँडिन्छ (अन्तर सरकारी वित्त व्यवस्थापन ऐन, २०७४)।

question: Who chairs the National Security Council of Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्को अध्यक्ष को हुन्छ?
explanation: The National Security Council is chaired by the Prime Minister (Article 266).
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्को अध्यक्ष प्रधानमन्त्री हुन्छन् (धारा २६६)।

question: How is the President of Nepal elected?
question_ne: नेपालको राष्ट्रपति कसरी निर्वाचित हुन्छ?
options: By an electoral college of members of the Federal Parliament and the Provincial Assemblies, with weighted votes
By the House of Representatives alone
options_ne: मतभारसहित सङ्घीय संसद् र प्रदेश सभाका सदस्यहरूको निर्वाचक मण्डलबाट
explanation: The President is elected by an electoral college comprising members of the Federal Parliament and Provincial Assemblies, with votes weighted by population (Article 62).
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रपति सङ्घीय संसद् र प्रदेश सभाका सदस्यहरू भएको निर्वाचक मण्डलबाट निर्वाचित हुन्छन्, जहाँ मतभार जनसङ्ख्याका आधारमा निर्धारण हुन्छ (धारा ६२)।

question: According to the Constitution, the President and the Vice-President of Nepal must be of what kind?
question_ne: संविधान अनुसार नेपालका राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपति कस्ता हुनुपर्छ?
options: Of the same sex and community
Both members of the same political party
Of different sexes and from different communities
explanation: The President and Vice-President must be of different sexes and from different communities (Article 70).
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपति फरक लिङ्गका र फरक समुदायका हुनुपर्छ (धारा ७०)।

question: What majority is required to pass a motion of impeachment against the President of Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालको राष्ट्रपतिविरुद्ध महाभियोगको प्रस्ताव पारित गर्न कति बहुमत आवश्यक पर्छ?
options: Simple majority of the House of Representatives
Three-fourths majority of the National Assembly
Two-thirds majority of the total membership of both Houses of the Federal Parliament
Two-thirds majority of the House of Representatives only
options_ne: सङ्घीय संसद्का दुवै सदनका सम्पूर्ण सदस्यहरूको दुई-तिहाइ बहुमत
explanation: Impeachment of the President requires a two-thirds majority of the total membership of both Houses (Article 101).
explanation_ne: राष्ट्रपतिविरुद्धको महाभियोग सङ्घीय संसद्का दुवै सदनका सम्पूर्ण सदस्यहरूको दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट पारित हुनुपर्छ (धारा १०१)।

question: The Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives must be from different what?
question_ne: प्रतिनिधि सभाका सभामुख र उपसभामुख फरक के हुनुपर्छ?
options: Different political parties and different sexes
options_ne: फरक राजनीतिक दल र फरक लिङ्ग
explanation: The Speaker and Deputy Speaker must belong to different political parties and be of different sexes (Article 91).
explanation_ne: सभामुख र उपसभामुख फरक राजनीतिक दलका र फरक लिङ्गका हुनुपर्छ (धारा ९१)।

question: Which article provides that every citizen has the right to free basic health services from the State?
question_ne: प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई राज्यबाट निःशुल्क आधारभूत स्वास्थ्य सेवा पाउने हक कुन धाराले दिएको छ?
explanation: Article 35(1): every citizen has the right to free basic health services from the State.
explanation_ne: धारा ३५(१): प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई राज्यबाट निःशुल्क आधारभूत स्वास्थ्य सेवा पाउने हक हुन्छ।

question: Under Article 31, up to which level is education free for every citizen in Nepal?
question_ne: धारा ३१ अनुसार नेपालमा प्रत्येक नागरिकका लागि कुन तहसम्म शिक्षा निःशुल्क छ?
options: Free education only up to the primary level
Free and compulsory basic education, and free education up to the secondary level
Free education up to the bachelor's level
options_ne: निःशुल्क तथा अनिवार्य आधारभूत शिक्षा र माध्यमिक तहसम्म निःशुल्क शिक्षा
explanation: Article 31 guarantees free and compulsory basic education and free education up to the secondary level.
explanation_ne: धारा ३१ ले निःशुल्क तथा अनिवार्य आधारभूत शिक्षा र माध्यमिक तहसम्म निःशुल्क शिक्षाको प्रत्याभूति गर्छ।

question: What does Article 26(3) prohibit in the exercise of religious freedom?
question_ne: धारा २६(३) ले धार्मिक स्वतन्त्रताको प्रयोगमा के निषेध गरेको छ?
options: Converting another person from one religion to another
options_ne: अर्को व्यक्तिलाई एक धर्मबाट अर्को धर्ममा परिवर्तन गराउनु
explanation: Article 26(3) prohibits converting another person from one religion to another.
explanation_ne: धारा २६(३) ले एक धर्मबाट अर्को धर्ममा कसैलाई धर्म परिवर्तन गराउन निषेध गरेको छ।

question: Under Article 20, can a person be punished for an act that was not an offence when it was committed?
question_ne: धारा २० अनुसार कुनै कार्य गर्दाको समयमा अपराध नभएको कार्यका लागि व्यक्तिलाई सजाय दिन सकिन्छ?
options: Yes — if Parliament later makes it an offence
Yes — with the Supreme Court's permission
explanation: Article 20 prohibits retrospective punishment: no person shall be punished for an act which was not punishable by law when committed.
explanation_ne: धारा २० ले भूतलक्षी सजाय निषेध गर्छ: कार्य गर्दाको समयमा कानुनले सजाय नहुने कार्यका लागि कसैलाई सजाय दिन सकिँदैन।

question: What does Article 38 guarantee to women regarding representation in state bodies?
question_ne: धारा ३८ ले महिलालाई राज्यका निकायहरूमा प्रतिनिधित्वबारे के प्रत्याभूति गरेको छ?
options: Right to 50% reservation in all jobs
Right to free higher education only
Right to proportional inclusion in all state bodies
Right to exemption from all taxes
options_ne: Right to ५०% reservation in all jobs
Right to free higher education only
Right to proportional inclusion in all state bodies
Right to exemption from all taxes
explanation: Article 38(4) guarantees women the right to proportional inclusion in all bodies of the State.
explanation_ne: धारा ३८(४) ले महिलालाई राज्यका सबै निकायमा समानुपातिक समावेशीकरणको हकको प्रत्याभूति गर्छ।

question: Under Article 39, children must not be recruited into which of the following?
question_ne: धारा ३९ अनुसार बालबालिकालाई कुनमा भर्ना गर्नु हुँदैन?
options: The army, police or armed groups, or used in armed conflict
options_ne: सेना, प्रहरी वा सशस्त्र समूह वा सशस्त्र द्वन्द्वमा प्रयोग
explanation: Article 39 prohibits the recruitment or use of children in the army, police or armed groups and in armed conflict.
explanation_ne: धारा ३९ ले बालबालिकालाई सेना, प्रहरी वा सशस्त्र समूहमा भर्ना गर्न वा सशस्त्र द्वन्द्वमा प्रयोग गर्न निषेध गर्छ।

question: What does Article 40(5) provide for landless Dalit families?
question_ne: धारा ४०(५) ले भूमिहीन दलित परिवारका लागि के व्यवस्था गरेको छ?
options: They shall be exempted from all land taxes
They shall be given government jobs
They shall be given free housing in cities
They shall be provided with land once, in accordance with law
options_ne: उनीहरूलाई सबै भूमि करबाट छुट दिइनेछ
उनीहरूलाई कानुनबमोजिम एक पटक जग्गा उपलब्ध गराइनेछ
explanation: Article 40(5): landless Dalit families shall be provided with land once in accordance with law.
explanation_ne: धारा ४०(५): भूमिहीन दलित परिवारलाई कानुनबमोजिम एक पटक जग्गा उपलब्ध गराइनेछ।

question: What remedy does Article 30(2) give to a victim of environmental pollution?
question_ne: धारा ३०(२) ले वातावरणीय प्रदूषणको पीडितलाई के उपचार दिन्छ?
options: Right to free medical treatment abroad
Right to obtain compensation from the polluter in accordance with law
Right to imprison the polluter directly
Right to close the polluting industry personally
options_ne: प्रदूषण गर्ने उद्योग आफैँ बन्द गर्ने हक
explanation: Article 30(2): a victim of environmental pollution has the right to obtain compensation from the polluter in accordance with law.
explanation_ne: धारा ३०(२): वातावरणीय प्रदूषणबाट पीडित व्यक्तिले कानुनबमोजिम प्रदूषकबाट क्षतिपूर्ति पाउने हक हुन्छ।

question: Under Article 44, what right does a consumer have if harmed by substandard goods or services?
question_ne: धारा ४४ अनुसार गुणस्तरहीन वस्तु वा सेवाबाट हानि पुगेको उपभोक्तालाई के हक छ?
options: Right to a full refund plus double damages automatically
Right to close the seller's business
Right to obtain compensation in accordance with law
Right to free goods for life
options_ne: स्वतः पूर्ण फिर्ता र दोब्बर क्षतिपूर्ति पाउने हक
explanation: Article 44: a consumer who suffers loss from substandard goods or services has the right to compensation in accordance with law.
explanation_ne: धारा ४४: गुणस्तरहीन वस्तु वा सेवाबाट हानि व्यहोरेका उपभोक्तालाई कानुनबमोजिम क्षतिपूर्ति पाउने हक हुन्छ।

question: What minimum share of women must there be in the Federal Parliament as a whole, through first-past-the-post and proportional representation combined?
question_ne: प्रत्यक्ष र समानुपातिक दुवै प्रणालीबाट गरी सङ्घीय संसद्मा महिलाको न्यूनतम हिस्सा कति हुनुपर्छ?
explanation: Article 84(8) requires that at least one-third of the total members of the Federal Parliament be women.
explanation_ne: धारा ८४(८) अनुसार सङ्घीय संसद्का कुल सदस्यमध्ये कम्तीमा एक तिहाइ महिला हुनुपर्छ।

question: Which constitution was in force in Nepal immediately before the Constitution of Nepal 2072?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ भन्दा ठीक अघि नेपालमा कुन संविधान लागू थियो?
options: The Constitution of the Kingdom of Nepal 2047
options_ne: The Constitution of the Kingdom of Nepal २०४७
explanation: The Interim Constitution of Nepal 2063 was in force until the Constitution of Nepal 2072 was promulgated.
explanation_ne: नेपालको अन्तरिम संविधान, २०६३ नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ जारी नभएसम्म लागू थियो।

question: Which Constituent Assembly promulgated the Constitution of Nepal 2072?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान, २०७२ कुन संविधान सभाले जारी गरेको थियो?
explanation: The Second Constituent Assembly, elected in November 2013, promulgated the Constitution on 20 September 2015.
explanation_ne: नोभेम्बर २०१३ मा निर्वाचित दोस्रो संविधान सभाले २० सेप्टेम्बर २०१५ मा संविधान जारी गरेको थियो।

question: Under Article 42, what does the right to social justice require the State to ensure?
question_ne: धारा ४२ अनुसार सामाजिक न्यायको हकले राज्यलाई के सुनिश्चित गर्न लगाउँछ?
options: Reservation of 50% of jobs for one community
Proportional inclusion and participation of economically, socially or educationally backward groups in state bodies
options_ne: Reservation of ५०% of jobs for one community
Proportional inclusion and participation of economically, socially or educationally backward groups in state bodies
explanation: Article 42 requires proportional inclusion of citizens who are economically, socially or educationally backward, including women, Dalits, indigenous peoples and Madhesis, in state bodies.
explanation_ne: धारा ४२ ले आर्थिक, सामाजिक वा शैक्षिक रूपमा पछाडि परेका नागरिकहरूको राज्यका निकायहरूमा समानुपातिक समावेशीकरण आवश्यक गर्छ।

question: The committee ___ decided to postpone the meeting.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: The committee ___ decided to postpone the meeting.
explanation: A committee acting as one body takes a singular verb.
explanation_ne: एउटै निकायका रूपमा काम गर्ने समितिसँग एकवचन क्रिया प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: I have been living here ___ 2015.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: I have been living here ___ २०१५.
explanation: 'Since' is used with a point of time; 'for' is used with a period of time.
explanation_ne: समयको बिन्दुसँग 'since' र अवधिसँग 'for' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: By this time tomorrow, I ___ finished the work.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: By this time tomorrow, I ___ finished the work.
explanation: An action completed before a future point uses the future perfect (will have + past participle).
explanation_ne: भविष्यको कुनै बिन्दुभन्दा अगाडि सकिने कार्यका लागि future perfect प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: If I were rich, I ___ travel the world.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: If I were rich, I ___ travel the world.
explanation: A second conditional (unreal present) uses would + base verb.
explanation_ne: दोस्रो conditional (अवास्तविक वर्तमान) मा would + base verb प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: The news ___ shocking.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: The news ___ shocking.
explanation: 'News' is an uncountable noun and takes a singular verb.
explanation_ne: 'News' अगणनीय नाम हो र एकवचन क्रिया लिन्छ।

question: Each of the students ___ a book.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: Each of the students ___ a book.
explanation: 'Each of' takes a singular verb.
explanation_ne: 'Each of' पछि एकवचन क्रिया प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ present.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ present.
explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject (students).
explanation_ne: 'Neither...nor' मा क्रिया नजिकको कर्तासँग मिल्छ।

question: He asked me where I ___.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: He asked me where I ___.
explanation: In indirect speech, the present simple shifts to the past simple.
explanation_ne: अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा present simple, past simple मा बदलिन्छ।

question: She said that she ___ tired.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: She said that she ___ tired.
explanation: In indirect speech, 'am' becomes 'was'.
explanation_ne: अप्रत्यक्ष कथनमा 'am' बदलिएर 'was' हुन्छ।

question: It is high time we ___.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: It is high time we ___.
explanation: After 'It is high time', the past simple is used to express that something should already have happened.
explanation_ne: 'It is high time' पछि past simple प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: I wish I ___ a car.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: I wish I ___ a car.
explanation: After 'wish' for a present unreal situation, the past simple is used.
explanation_ne: 'Wish' पछि वर्तमान अवास्तविक अवस्थाका लागि past simple प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: The patient ___ before the doctor arrived.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: The patient ___ before the doctor arrived.
explanation: The earlier of two past actions uses the past perfect.
explanation_ne: दुई विगतका कार्यमध्ये पहिले भएको कार्यका लागि past perfect प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Hardly had I reached the station ___ the train left.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: Hardly had I reached the station ___ the train left.
explanation: 'Hardly...when' is the correct correlative pair.
explanation_ne: 'Hardly...when' सही जोडी हो।

question: No sooner had he entered ___ the lights went out.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: No sooner had he entered ___ the lights went out.
explanation: 'No sooner...than' is the correct correlative pair.
explanation_ne: 'No sooner...than' सही जोडी हो।

question: Scarcely had we started ___ it began to rain.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: Scarcely had we started ___ it began to rain.
explanation: 'Scarcely...when' is the correct correlative pair.
explanation_ne: 'Scarcely...when' सही जोडी हो।

question: The book, along with the pens, ___ on the table.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: The book, along with the pens, ___ on the table.
explanation: A phrase introduced by 'along with' does not change the number of the subject (book).
explanation_ne: 'Along with' ले कर्ताको सङ्ख्या बदल्दैन।

question: A number of students ___ absent.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: A number of students ___ absent.
explanation: 'A number of' takes a plural verb.
explanation_ne: 'A number of' पछि बहुवचन क्रिया प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: The police ___ investigating the case.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: The police ___ investigating the case.

question_ne: A, B का बुबा हुन्। B, C की आमा हुन्। A, C का के हुन्?
explanation: A is the father of C's mother, so A is C's maternal grandfather.
explanation_ne: A, C की आमाका बुबा हुन्, त्यसैले A, C का मामा हजुरबुबा (नाना) हुन्।

question: Ravi is the son of Sita. Sita is the sister of Hari. How is Hari related to Ravi?
question_ne: रवि सीताका छोरा हुन्। सीता हरिकी बहिनी हुन्। हरि रविका के हुन्?
explanation: Hari is the brother of Ravi's mother, so he is Ravi's maternal uncle.
explanation_ne: हरि रविकी आमाका दाजु हुन्, त्यसैले उनी रविका मामा हुन्।

question: Mina's mother is the only daughter of Rina's father. How is Rina related to Mina?
question_ne: मिनाकी आमा रिनाका बुबाकी एक्ली छोरी हुन्। रिना मिनाकी के हुन्?
explanation: Mina's mother is Rina's father's only daughter, so Mina's mother is Rina's sister; Rina is Mina's maternal aunt.
explanation_ne: मिनाकी आमा रिनाकी बहिनी हुन्; त्यसैले रिना मिनाकी माइजू (मावली फुपू) हुन्।

question: A man points to a woman and says, 'Her mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
question_ne: एक पुरुषले एक महिलातर्फ औंल्याउँदै भन्छन्, 'उनकी आमा मेरी आमाकी एक्ली छोरी हुन्।' ती महिला ती पुरुषकी के हुन्?
explanation: The woman's mother is the man's sister (the only daughter of his mother), so the woman is the man's niece.
explanation_ne: महिलाकी आमा पुरुषकी बहिनी हुन् (उनकी आमाकी एक्ली छोरी), त्यसैले महिला पुरुषकी भान्जी हुन्।

question: P is the brother of Q. Q is the sister of R. R is the father of S. How is P related to S?
question_ne: P, Q का दाजु हुन्। Q, R की बहिनी हुन्। R, S का बुबा हुन्। P, S का के हुन्?
explanation: P is the brother of S's father, so P is S's paternal uncle.
explanation_ne: P, S का बुबाका दाजु हुन्, त्यसैले P, S का काका हुन्।

question: A walks 5 km north, turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right and walks 5 km. How far is A from the starting point and in which direction?
question_ne: A उत्तरतर्फ ५ किमी हिँड्छ, दायाँ मोडिएर ३ किमी हिँड्छ, फेरि दायाँ मोडिएर ५ किमी हिँड्छ। A सुरुको बिन्दुबाट कति टाढा र कुन दिशामा छ?
explanation: After the moves A is at (3, 0) relative to the start — 3 km east.
explanation_ne: चालपछि A सुरुको बिन्दुबाट (३, ०) मा छ — पूर्वतर्फ ३ किमी।

question: A walks 4 km east, turns left and walks 3 km. How far is A from the starting point?
question_ne: A पूर्वतर्फ ४ किमी हिँड्छ, बायाँ मोडिएर ३ किमी हिँड्छ। A सुरुको बिन्दुबाट कति टाढा छ?
explanation: By Pythagoras: √(4² + 3²) = 5 km.
explanation_ne: पाइथागोरसअनुसार: √(४² + ३²) = ५ किमी।

question: A walks 6 km south, turns left and walks 8 km. How far is A from the starting point?
question_ne: A दक्षिणतर्फ ६ किमी हिँड्छ, बायाँ मोडिएर ८ किमी हिँड्छ। A सुरुको बिन्दुबाट कति टाढा छ?
explanation: By Pythagoras: √(6² + 8²) = 10 km.
explanation_ne: पाइथागोरसअनुसार: √(६² + ८²) = १० किमी।

question: Facing north, a person turns 90° clockwise, then 180° anticlockwise. Which direction is the person now facing?
question_ne: उत्तरतर्फ फर्केको व्यक्ति ९०° दक्षिणावर्त घुम्छ, त्यसपछि १८०° वामावर्त घुम्छ। अब व्यक्ति कुन दिशातर्फ फर्केको छ?
explanation: 90° clockwise from north is east; 180° anticlockwise from east is west.
explanation_ne: उत्तरबाट ९०° दक्षिणावर्त घुम्दा पूर्व हुन्छ; पूर्वबाट १८०° वामावर्त घुम्दा पश्चिम हुन्छ।

question: A walks 10 km west, turns right and walks 10 km, then turns right and walks 10 km. In which direction is A from the starting point?
question_ne: A पश्चिमतर्फ १० किमी हिँड्छ, दायाँ मोडिएर १० किमी हिँड्छ, फेरि दायाँ मोडिएर १० किमी हिँड्छ। A सुरुको बिन्दुबाट कुन दिशामा छ?
explanation: After the three legs A is at (−10, +10) relative to the start if north is +y — directly north of the start.
explanation_ne: तीन चरणपछि A सुरुको बिन्दुबाट ठिक उत्तरमा छ।

question: What is the next term in the series: A1, C3, F6, J10, O15, ?
question_ne: शृङ्खलाको अर्को पद के हो: A1, C3, F6, J10, O15, ?
explanation: Letters move +2, +3, +4, +5, +6 (A, C, F, J, O, U); numbers are triangular: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21.

question: What is the next term in the series: B2, D4, H8, N14, ?
question_ne: शृङ्खलाको अर्को पद के हो: B2, D4, H8, N14, ?
explanation: Letters move +2, +4, +6, +8 (B, D, H, N, V); numbers 2, 4, 8, 14, 22 (differences +2, +4, +6, +8).

question: What is the next term in the series: Z1, X4, V9, T16, ?
question_ne: शृङ्खलाको अर्को पद के हो: Z1, X4, V9, T16, ?
explanation: Letters go back by 2 (Z, X, V, T, R); numbers are squares: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25.
explanation_ne: अक्षर २ ले पछाडि जान्छ (Z, X, V, T, R); सङ्ख्या वर्ग हुन्: १, ४, ९, १६, २५।

question: In a code, A = 26, B = 25, C = 24 (reverse alphabet positions). What is the code for CAT?
question_ne: एउटा कोडमा A = 26, B = 25, C = 24 (उल्टो वर्णमाला स्थान) छ। CAT को कोड के हो?
explanation: Reverse positions: C = 24, A = 26, T = 7, so CAT = 24-26-7.

question: A train 240 m long runs at 72 km/h. How long does it take to cross an electric pole?
question_ne: ७२ किमी/घण्टाको गतिमा दौडिरहेको २४० मिटर लामो रेलले एउटा बिजुलीको खम्बा पार गर्न कति समय लिन्छ?
explanation: Time = length ÷ speed = 240 m ÷ 72 km/h (20 m/s) = 12 seconds.

question: A train 300 m long runs at 54 km/h. How long does it take to cross a man standing on the platform?
question_ne: ५४ किमी/घण्टाको गतिमा दौडिरहेको ३०० मिटर लामो रेलले प्लेटफर्ममा उभिएको मानिसलाई पार गर्न कति समय लिन्छ?
explanation: Time = length ÷ speed = 300 m ÷ 54 km/h (15 m/s) = 20 seconds.

question: A train 200 m long crosses a 400 m long platform in 30 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
question_ne: २०० मिटर लामो रेलले ४०० मिटर लामो प्लेटफर्म ३० सेकेन्डमा पार गर्छ। रेलको गति किमी/घण्टामा कति छ?
explanation: Total distance = 200 + 400 = 600 m in 30 s, so speed = 20 m/s = 72 km/h.

question: A train 150 m long runs at 60 km/h. How long does it take to cross a 250 m long bridge?
question_ne: ६० किमी/घण्टाको गतिमा दौडिरहेको १५० मिटर लामो रेलले २५० मिटर लामो पुल पार गर्न कति समय लिन्छ?
explanation: Total distance = 150 + 250 = 400 m; speed 60 km/h = 16.67 m/s; time = 400 ÷ 16.67 = 24 seconds.

question: Two trains 120 m and 180 m long run in opposite directions at 50 km/h and 40 km/h. How long do they take to cross each other?
question_ne: १२० मिटर र १८० मिटर लामो दुई रेल विपरीत दिशामा ५० किमी/घण्टा र ४० किमी/घण्टाको गतिमा दौडिरहेका छन्। तिनीहरूले एकअर्कालाई पार गर्न कति समय लिन्छन्?
explanation: Relative speed = 50 + 40 = 90 km/h = 25 m/s; total length = 300 m; time = 300 ÷ 25 = 12 seconds.

question: A boat's speed in still water is 10 km/h and the speed of the stream is 2 km/h. What is the boat's downstream speed?
question_ne: स्थिर पानीमा डुङ्गाको गति १० किमी/घण्टा र खोलाको गति २ किमी/घण्टा छ। डुङ्गाको धारतर्फको (downstream) गति कति छ?
explanation: Downstream speed = still-water speed + stream speed = 10 + 2 = 12 km/h.
explanation_ne: धारतर्फको गति = स्थिर पानीको गति + खोलाको गति = १० + २ = १२ किमी/घण्टा।

question: A boat's speed in still water is 10 km/h and the speed of the stream is 2 km/h. What is the boat's upstream speed?
question_ne: स्थिर पानीमा डुङ्गाको गति १० किमी/घण्टा र खोलाको गति २ किमी/घण्टा छ। डुङ्गाको धारविपरीतको (upstream) गति कति छ?
explanation: Upstream speed = still-water speed − stream speed = 10 − 2 = 8 km/h.
explanation_ne: धारविपरीतको गति = स्थिर पानीको गति − खोलाको गति = १० − २ = ८ किमी/घण्टा।

question: A boat goes 12 km downstream and 8 km upstream in equal time. If the stream speed is 2 km/h, what is the boat's speed in still water?
question_ne: एउटा डुङ्गा बराबर समयमा धारतर्फ १२ किमी र धारविपरीत ८ किमी जान्छ। खोलाको गति २ किमी/घण्टा भए, स्थिर पानीमा डुङ्गाको गति कति छ?
explanation: Downstream speed = 12/t and upstream = 8/t; still-water speed = (12 + 8) ÷ (2t) × t = 10 km/h.
explanation_ne: स्थिर पानीको गति = (धारतर्फको गति + धारविपरीतको गति) ÷ २ = (१२ + ८) ÷ २ = १० किमी/घण्टा।

question: A man rows 24 km downstream in 2 hours and 12 km upstream in 2 hours. What is the speed of the stream?
question_ne: एक मानिस २ घण्टामा धारतर्फ २४ किमी र २ घण्टामा धारविपरीत १२ किमी डुङ्गा चलाउँछ। खोलाको गति कति छ?
explanation: Downstream speed = 12 km/h, upstream = 6 km/h; stream speed = (12 − 6) ÷ 2 = 3 km/h.
explanation_ne: धारतर्फको गति = १२ किमी/घण्टा, धारविपरीत = ६ किमी/घण्टा; खोलाको गति = (१२ − ६) ÷ २ = ३ किमी/घण्टा।

question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 6 hours and pipe B in 8 hours. Working together, how long do they take to fill the tank?
question_ne: पाइप A ले ट्याङ्की ६ घण्टामा र पाइप B ले ८ घण्टामा भर्न सक्छ। सँगै काम गर्दा ट्याङ्की भर्न कति समय लाग्छ?
explanation: Combined rate = 1/6 + 1/8 = 7/24 per hour, so time = 24/7 ≈ 3.43 hours ≈ 3 hours 26 minutes.

question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 4 hours. Pipe B can empty the full tank in 6 hours. If both are opened together, how long will the tank take to fill?
question_ne: पाइप A ले ट्याङ्की ४ घण्टामा भर्न सक्छ। पाइप B ले भरिएको ट्याङ्की ६ घण्टामा खाली गर्न सक्छ। दुवै सँगै खोलिए ट्याङ्की भर्न कति समय लाग्छ?
explanation: Net rate = 1/4 − 1/6 = 1/12 per hour, so time = 12 hours.

question: Two pipes can fill a tank in 10 hours and 15 hours respectively. How long will they take working together?
question_ne: दुई पाइपले ट्याङ्की क्रमशः १० घण्टा र १५ घण्टामा भर्न सक्छन्। सँगै काम गर्दा कति समय लाग्छ?
explanation: Combined rate = 1/10 + 1/15 = 1/6 per hour, so time = 6 hours.
explanation_ne: संयुक्त दर = १/१० + १/१५ = १/६ प्रति घण्टा; समय = ६ घण्टा।

question: A tap can fill a tank in 12 hours. After 4 hours, a second tap that fills the tank in 8 hours is also opened. How much longer will it take to fill the tank?
question_ne: एउटा धाराले ट्याङ्की १२ घण्टामा भर्न सक्छ। ४ घण्टापछि ८ घण्टामा भर्ने दोस्रो धारा पनि खोलिन्छ। ट्याङ्की भर्न थप कति समय लाग्छ?
explanation: After 4 hours, 1/3 is filled; 2/3 remains. Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/8 = 5/24 per hour; time = (2/3) ÷ (5/24) = 3.2 hours = 3 hours 12 minutes.

question: A 60-litre mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 2:1. How much water must be added to make the ratio 1:1?
question_ne: ६० लिटरको मिश्रणमा दूध र पानीको अनुपात २:१ छ। अनुपात १:१ बनाउन कति पानी थप्नुपर्छ?
explanation: Milk = 40 L, water = 20 L. To make 1:1, water must equal milk (40 L), so add 20 L.
explanation_ne: दूध = ४० लि, पानी = २० लि। १:१ बनाउन पानी दूधबराबर (४० लि) हुनुपर्छ, त्यसैले २० लि थप्नुपर्छ।

question: In what ratio must tea costing Rs 120 per kg be mixed with tea costing Rs 180 per kg so that the mixture costs Rs 150 per kg?
question_ne: प्रति केजी रु १२० पर्ने चियालाई प्रति केजी रु १८० पर्ने चियासँग कुन अनुपातमा मिसाउँदा मिश्रणको मूल्य प्रति केजी रु १५० हुन्छ?

question: A mixture of 40 litres contains alcohol and water in the ratio 3:1. How much alcohol must be added to make the ratio 4:1?
question_ne: ४० लिटरको मिश्रणमा अल्कोहल र पानीको अनुपात ३:१ छ। अनुपात ४:१ बनाउन कति अल्कोहल थप्नुपर्छ?
explanation: Alcohol = 30 L, water = 10 L. For 4:1, alcohol must be 40 L, so add 10 L.
explanation_ne: अल्कोहल = ३० लि, पानी = १० लि। ४:१ बनाउन अल्कोहल ४० लि हुनुपर्छ, त्यसैले १० लि थप्नुपर्छ।

question: In how many ways can 5 books be arranged in a row on a shelf?
question_ne: ५ वटा पुस्तकलाई ताकमा पङ्क्तिमा कति तरिकाले राख्न सकिन्छ?

question: How many different 2-digit numbers can be formed using the digits 1, 2, 3, 4 without repetition?
question_ne: १, २, ३, ४ अङ्कहरू प्रयोग गरी पुनरावृत्ति नगरी कति फरक २-अङ्के सङ्ख्या बनाउन सकिन्छ?
explanation: 4 choices for the tens digit × 3 for the units digit = 12.
explanation_ne: दशकको अङ्कका लागि ४ विकल्प × एकाइको अङ्कका लागि ३ विकल्प = १२।

question: In how many ways can a committee of 2 people be chosen from 6 people?
question_ne: ६ जनाबाट २ जनाको समिति कति तरिकाले छान्न सकिन्छ?

question: How many 3-letter words (meaningful or not) can be formed from the letters A, B, C, D without repetition?
question_ne: A, B, C, D अक्षरहरूबाट पुनरावृत्ति नगरी कति ३-अक्षरका शब्द बनाउन सकिन्छ?

question: Two angles of a triangle are 60° and 70°. What is the third angle?
question_ne: त्रिभुजका दुई कोण ६०° र ७०° छन्। तेस्रो कोण कति छ?
explanation: Angles of a triangle sum to 180°: 180 − 60 − 70 = 50°.

question: What is the circumference of a circle of radius 7 cm? (Use π = 22/7)
question_ne: ७ सेमी त्रिज्या भएको वृत्तको परिधि कति छ? (π = 22/7 प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्)
explanation: Circumference = 2πr = 2 × (22/7) × 7 = 44 cm.

question: What is the diagonal of a rectangle 12 cm long and 5 cm wide?
question_ne: १२ सेमी लामो र ५ सेमी चौडा आयतको विकर्ण कति छ?
explanation: Diagonal = √(12² + 5²) = √169 = 13 cm.

question: What is the perimeter of an equilateral triangle of side 6 cm?
question_ne: ६ सेमी भुजा भएको समबाहु त्रिभुजको परिमिति कति छ?
explanation: Perimeter = 3 × side = 3 × 6 = 18 cm.

question: What is the unit digit of 7 raised to the power 2025?
question_ne: ७ को घात २०२५ को एकाइ अङ्क कति छ?
explanation: Powers of 7 end in a cycle 7, 9, 3, 1. 2025 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 1, so the unit digit is 7.
explanation_ne: ७ का घातहरूको एकाइ अङ्क ७, ९, ३, १ को चक्रमा दोहोरिन्छ। २०२५ ÷ ४ को शेष १ भएकाले एकाइ अङ्क ७ हुन्छ।

question: What is the unit digit of 3 raised to the power 100?
question_ne: ३ को घात १०० को एकाइ अङ्क कति छ?
explanation: Powers of 3 end in a cycle 3, 9, 7, 1. 100 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 0, so the unit digit is 1.
explanation_ne: ३ का घातहरूको एकाइ अङ्क ३, ९, ७, १ को चक्रमा दोहोरिन्छ। १०० ÷ ४ को शेष ० भएकाले एकाइ अङ्क १ हुन्छ।

question: What is the unit digit of 2 raised to the power 50?
question_ne: २ को घात ५० को एकाइ अङ्क कति छ?
